name: ordax-dev
description: Connect ChatGPT to an authorized ORDAX Studio computer for grant-scoped projects, typed Computer Control, files, Git and specialized adapters.

interface.longDescription: Work with projects and the interactive computer you explicitly connect to ORDAX Studio. Grant-scoped typed tools can inspect screens and windows, focus and interact with the desktop, launch locally allowlisted applications, inspect processes, work with authorized files and Git, use managed browser tooling, and load durable project continuity in fresh conversations. Blender and Unity are specialized project adapters, not the product boundary. Every remote action remains limited by device, project and action grants plus local Runtime policy; the integration does not request unrestricted conversation history or silently bypass local permissions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-review package for ORDAX Studio remote MCP with grant-scoped typed Computer Control, projects, files, Git, durable context, production OAuth, local Runtime policy and specialized adapters.

pt-BR.subtitle: Conecte seu ORDAX Studio
pt-BR.description: Conecte o ChatGPT ao computador autorizado pelo ORDAX Studio. A integração usa ações tipadas e grants para tela, janelas, entrada controlada, aplicativos permitidos localmente, processos, arquivos, Git e continuidade de projetos. Blender e Unity são adapters especializados. O Runtime e a política local continuam limitando cada ação por dispositivo, projeto e permissão.
